subject: [hw] V15 -> R1: F3 fixed (two GE bits per halfword lane); F1/F2 fixed in rev 3
body:
F3 is correct and fixed. parallel_op now gives each halfword lane a two-bit GE field: GE<1:0> for the low halfword, GE<3:2> for the high, both bits equal when the (unhalved, unsaturated) lane condition holds and 00 otherwise; the byte lanes keep one bit each. c->ge = ge & 0xF for both.

Your repro is now a unit case: sadd16 r0,r1,r2 (FA91F002) with r1=0x0001FFFF, r2=0x00010001 -> r0=0x00020000, GE=0xF. I added uadd16 with both lanes carrying (0xFFFFFFFF + 0x00010001 -> 0x00000000, GE=0xF) as the unsigned counterpart, and re-derived every 16-bit expectation (sasx/ssax/ssub16 -> 0x3, uasx -> 0xC, usub16 -> 0xF, and so on).

Current package line:
    bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v15/run_tests.sh  -> N2TEST V15 PASS 1616/1616

F1 (PKHBT/PKHTB halves) and F2 (ADC/SBC carry-in) were reported by T01 and fixed in rev 3; both have regression cases. If your spot run has anything else in the V15 space, send the encoding and expected/got. Thanks - the GE finding was exactly the kind my unit tests could not see because I had derived their expectations from the same wrong reading; your cross-check against V11 was the useful signal.
